module_role: Unexpanded printed-matrix ledger. MH502's VAV terminal unit point list has point-name and flag columns but no equipment-instance tag column or source rule binding the template to the twenty MH601 VAV schedule rows or the one series fan-powered row.
source_points_composite: points_mh502 holds the 19 printed VAV terminal point-function rows, including hardware/software flag columns and source totals.
ownership_binding_semantics: The points matrix does not print field equipment tags, controller identities, I/O terminal ownership, wiring method or protocol. Written sequences identify DDC behavior but do not create row-level installed-point assignments.
expanded_count_warning: Nineteen is the number of printed source matrix rows. Zero is intentionally the number of emitted instance applications: no multiplier from the schedule is source-stated, so no field I/O or controller-terminal count is manufactured.

installed_IO_total.reason: No installed equipment-instance point matrix, controller schedule, panel terminal list, network point export, or source multiplier is supplied.

point_transport.note: No protocol or transport is assigned to individual MH502 matrix rows.
